about_the_game:
BARREN is an immersive sim roguelike with survival components.

Travel across a desolate industrial world aboard your vehicle, master your tools, and survive long enough to move forward.

Core Combat & Threats

  • Methodical, unforgiving combat
    Encounters are slow, tense, and deliberate. Mistakes are costly and often irreversible.

  • Procedural, realistic weapon handling
    Firearms are handled manually through a physical, procedural system.

  • Lethal mechanical enemies
    Drones, wall-mounted turrets, and automated systems that do not hesitate.

  • Unforgiving AI
    Enemies offer no warnings, no mercy, and no second chances.

Systems & Simulation

  • Physically simulated interactions
    Weapons, enemies, and world systems follow consistent physical rules.

  • Modular systems
    The world and your equipment are built from interacting systems that can fail or be modified.

  • Limited resources
    Ammunition, tools, and time are scarce, with long-term consequences.

Exploration & Survival

  • Immersive environments
    Dark, oppressive spaces designed for tension, navigation, and observation.

  • Tool-driven progression
    Find and use the tools you need to survive, repair systems, and move forward.

  • Vehicular survival
    Your vehicle is your lifeline: fragile, modular, and essential to progression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Quad-core+ with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 (shader model 4.0) support, VRAM 2+ GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: BARREN is a roguelike FPS where you cross a barren sci-fi world in a fragile vehicle, exploring isolated zones, fighting with realistic, manual firearms, and learning how machines and systems work to push a little further each run.
